title: Cheesy Veggie Ground, Potato, Carrot & Celery Soup

steps.text: Wash, dry, and medium dice potatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the potatoes and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the bowl with the potato and celery along with the carrots.
When the veggie ground is done, add vegetables to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add broth to the pot; stir to combine the soup, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 12-15 minutes.
Once the veggies are soft, add milk and cheese. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until the cheese is melted and combined, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
